_comment: Gate 0 pre-registration precondition 3 (reports/2026-07-18-gate0-prereg.md) -- frozen expected pins for arm 'miniwob', independent of any observed run receipt. Consumed by tools/check_gate0_codex.py::audit()'s expected_pins argument (schema_version 2, all tools.check_gate0_codex.PIN_FIELDS present) and, indirectly, by eval/score_gate0.py's SOURCE_PIN_FILES['readiness_dev'|'paid_gate0'].audit_paths.miniwob.expected_pins (hash-pinned there). See eval/fixtures/gate0_expected_pins.SOURCES.md for the full source-citation table (INDEPENDENCE LAW: no value here was copied from runs/gate0_readiness_2026-07-14/miniwob-v2/handshake-receipt.json or any other observed receipt).
_source_readiness: code-mandated constant: tools/check_gate0_codex.py:46 requires this exact string on every receipt; tools/run_gate0_codex.ps1:380 (`readiness = 'NO_GO_INSUFFICIENT_WAKES'`) and its pinned test tests/test_run_gate0_codex_launcher.py::test_launcher_is_free_handshake_only_and_fail_closed both hold the launcher to producing only this value until a separate paid launcher with real wake accounting exists.
_source_paid_execution_enabled: code-mandated constant: tools/check_gate0_codex.py:48 and tools/run_gate0_codex.ps1:381 (`paid_execution_enabled = $false`); the launcher contains no `codex exec` path (design doc reports/2026-07-13-minimum-north-star-gate-0-design.md:242-243).
_source_auth_method: code-mandated constant: tools/check_gate0_codex.py:50 and tools/run_gate0_codex.ps1:382; ChatGPT-subscription-only is constitutive of Gate 0 (pre-reg 'Fixed Codex brain, pool = ChatGPT/Codex subscription only').
_source_planned_model: (a) David's explicit decision, 2026-07-21: the Gate 0 brain pin is gpt-5.6-sol (OpenAI 'Sol'); the design-doc-era gpt-5.4 plan was stale. (b) Independently observed 2026-07-21 via `codex doctor` on the launch machine (codex-cli 0.144.3), Configuration section, verbatim line: 'model                    gpt-5.6-sol · openai' (auth section: 'stored auth mode           chatgpt') -- the install's current default model, NOT read from any run receipt. No `latest` alias per design doc:96-98 and tools/run_gate0_codex.ps1:145-147. Supersedes HANDOFF.md:53's and reports/2026-07-18-gate0-prereg.md:40's gpt-5.4 references (both merged docs describe the 2026-07-14 free-handshake era; the pre-reg itself says those values are 'NOT the frozen pin' and must be re-observed fresh -- this pin IS that re-observation). Must match the red pin exactly (CONSTANCY_FIELDS) -- it does.
_source_codex_version: freshly, independently observed 2026-07-19 by running `codex --version` on the launch machine (same command as tools/run_gate0_codex.ps1:162), NOT read from any receipt file. Matches the codex_version already narrated in HANDOFF.md:53 as the currently-installed CLI, confirming no drift since that free handshake -- this is corroboration of an independent observation, not the source of it.
_source_codex_path: freshly, independently resolved 2026-07-19 via `Get-Command codex -CommandType Application -All` filtered to the sole `.exe` candidate, exactly reproducing tools/run_gate0_codex.ps1:36-44,159-165's Resolve-CodexExecutable contract (exactly one `.exe` candidate found). Machine-specific by construction -- if Gate 0 launches from a different machine or a moved install, this pin correctly fails closed until re-frozen.
_source_codex_executable_sha256: freshly computed 2026-07-19: SHA-256 of the exact codex.exe resolved above (Get-FileSha256, same routine as tools/run_gate0_codex.ps1:32-34,386), NOT copied from any receipt's codex_executable_sha256 field.
_source_critical_config_transport: code-mandated constant: tools/check_gate0_codex.py:52 and tools/run_gate0_codex.ps1:307-318,387 (the $Overrides array is the effective config, not fresh-project trust).
_source_mcp_tools_observed: code-mandated constant list, exact order: tools/check_gate0_codex.py:13-14 (TOOLS['miniwob']), cross-checked against tools/run_gate0_codex.ps1:200-201 ($Tools for the miniwob branch) -- both sources agree.
_source_brain_config_sha256: re-derived 2026-07-21 (after David's gpt-5.6-sol model-pin decision; the model is embedded in $BrainConfigText, so this hash is model-dependent by construction) by AST-extracting and evaluating tools/run_gate0_codex.ps1's own $BrainConfigText assignment (lines 269-291) with Model='gpt-5.6-sol' bound as the launcher would bind it, then SHA-256 of the UTF-8-no-BOM bytes (Write-Utf8NoBom contract, lines 22-24) -- the exact deterministic content the real launcher produces, extracted via the same AST-parse technique tests/test_run_gate0_codex_launcher.py already uses (RESOLVER_HARNESS et al.), not hand-transcribed (the here-string is CRLF-internal, LF-terminal; hand transcription would risk a wrong hash). task_sha256 is model-independent and was verified unchanged by the same re-run. Identical for both arms by construction ($BrainConfigText does not depend on $Arm) -- this is also a CONSTANCY_FIELDS field, so it must match the red pin exactly; it does.
_source_task_sha256: computed 2026-07-19 the same AST-extraction way as brain_config_sha256, from tools/run_gate0_codex.ps1:202,259-262's miniwob $TaskSentence + $CommonTask + a trailing LF (Write-Utf8NoBom contract). The brief text matches the design intent for Arm W (reports/2026-07-18-gate0-prereg.md 'Arms' table: task instruction comes from the environment itself; the brief only states the five-episode/screen-pixels/mouse-and-keyboard constraint) and names no specific seed.
_source_config_sha256: Cannot be a single pre-pinned value even with the image digest now frozen (PR #117): config.toml embeds, verbatim, docker mount source paths derived from the launch -OutputDir ($WorldDir = OutputDir\world) plus the launching checkout's absolute paths ($Seeds, cwd=$RepoRoot) (tools/run_gate0_codex.ps1:244-256,292-302). One expected-pins file per arm serves BOTH scoring modes, whose pinned artifacts_dir differ (runs/gate0_readiness_dev/miniwob vs runs/gate0_paid/miniwob), so their config.toml bytes -- and hashes -- necessarily differ; a single value here would structurally fail one of the two modes. Deterministic recompute recipe at signature, once the launch checkout + per-mode OutputDir are fixed: evaluate $BrainConfigText + $WorldConfigText exactly as the launcher does with Model='gpt-5.6-sol' and ImageId='sha256:8bb3358e1421dc97c72c07809fdef048f63d64bdfddb170c4d0188337fe6fd0f' (now frozen, see world_image_id), then SHA-256 the UTF-8-no-BOM bytes (Write-Utf8NoBom contract). Fail-closed until then.
_source_codex_mcp_list_sha256: Same launch-invocation dependency as config_sha256, demonstrated empirically 2026-07-19: `codex mcp list --json` (codex-cli 0.144.3, isolated CODEX_HOME, the launcher's exact -c override transport) echoes the full transport `args` array (containing the OutputDir/checkout-derived mount paths and the image ID) and `cwd` verbatim in its JSON output, so its bytes -- and hash -- shift with the same launch-invocation paths. Same recompute recipe applies at signature.
_source_tool_schema_sha256: RESOLVED 2026-07-19, computed against the rebuilt image exactly as the launcher/checker will: ran tools/run_gate0_codex.ps1:348-375's live tools/list handshake verbatim (same 3-line JSON-RPC initialize/initialized/tools-list, `docker run -i --rm --network none` with the miniwob arm's mount shape) against the frozen image sha256:8bb3358e1421dc97c72c07809fdef048f63d64bdfddb170c4d0188337fe6fd0f, serialized the observed tools with PowerShell 5.1 `ConvertTo-Json -Depth 20 -Compress` + trailing LF, UTF-8 no BOM (the launcher's exact mcp-tools.json recipe), SHA-256 of those bytes. Observed inventory matched the frozen miniwob allowlist exactly. Read-only corroboration (not a source): byte-identical to runs/gate0_readiness_2026-07-14/miniwob-v2/mcp-tools.json -- expected, since the schema is a pure function of world_mcp.py, which is parity-identical across the rebuild. **2026-07-28 (batched world rebuild):** RE-DERIVED against the NEW rebuilt image by exactly the $0 recipe this note already describes -- never hand-edited. red's value is UNCHANGED, as expected: the batch touched no tool on red's list, and _static_tools() is a pure function of the game key's tool lists (adding the mkds/gba_generic keys cannot reach it). miniwob's value MOVED, also as expected: the batch rewrote the `click` and `press_key` tool descriptions -- the two that demonstrably misled the agent on a banked paid run -- and description text is inside the hashed tools/list payload.
_source_world_image_tag: code-mandated constant per arm: tools/check_gate0_codex.py:70 (`expected_tag = 'gb-mcp-world' if arm == 'red' else 'miniwob-world'`) and tools/run_gate0_codex.ps1:203 ($ImageTag).
_source_world_image_id: RE-FROZEN 2026-07-28 (batched world rebuild, branch feat/batched-world-rebuild-2026-07-28). BOTH world images were genuinely rebuilt from this branch's HEAD using an LF-forced `git -c core.autocrlf=false -c core.eol=lf archive HEAD` build context whose exported bytes were byte-verified against the git blobs BEFORE building, so the CRLF trap tools/run_gate0_codex.ps1:645-649 warns about cannot bite. This ID is the real `docker image inspect --format '{{.Id}}' <tag>` output of that rebuild -- the exact command tools/run_gate0_codex.ps1:638 and tools/gate0_appserver_arm.py:380 use -- and was cross-checked identically from PowerShell 5.1 and Git Bash. It supersedes the previous ID, which contains the pre-batch world_mcp.py and would now correctly trip tools/check_gate0_codex.py:86-88's stale_world_image check. Not read from any run receipt.
_source_host_code_sha256: RE-FROZEN 2026-07-28 (batched world rebuild, branch feat/batched-world-rebuild-2026-07-28). BOTH world images were genuinely rebuilt from this branch's HEAD using an LF-forced `git -c core.autocrlf=false -c core.eol=lf archive HEAD` build context whose exported bytes were byte-verified against the git blobs BEFORE building, so the CRLF trap tools/run_gate0_codex.ps1:645-649 warns about cannot bite. world_mcp.py's value is the canonical git blob at this branch's HEAD (`git cat-file blob HEAD:world_mcp.py` piped to sha256), matching world_mcp.py::code_sha256()'s contract and tools/run_gate0_codex.ps1:146,651-652's Get-CanonicalCodeSha256 -- computed directly from the repo, never from a receipt. It moved because this batch edited world_mcp.py (Kirby stage oracle, the mkds/gba_generic keys, and the two MiniWoB tool descriptions plus press_key name resolution). core/miniwob_world.py is UNTOUCHED by this batch; its value is carried forward and was re-verified by the same git-blob hash AND by the in-image extraction described under image_code_sha256.
_source_image_code_sha256: RE-FROZEN 2026-07-28 (batched world rebuild, branch feat/batched-world-rebuild-2026-07-28). BOTH world images were genuinely rebuilt from this branch's HEAD using an LF-forced `git -c core.autocrlf=false -c core.eol=lf archive HEAD` build context whose exported bytes were byte-verified against the git blobs BEFORE building, so the CRLF trap tools/run_gate0_codex.ps1:645-649 warns about cannot bite. EXTRACTED FROM THE REAL BUILT IMAGE, never forward-declared: ran tools/run_gate0_codex.ps1:659-661's exact $HashProgram inside the rebuilt image (`docker run --rm --network none --entrypoint python <image-id> -c $HashProgram /app/world_mcp.py /app/core/miniwob_world.py`). Both paths returned exactly the values pinned here, equal to the host git blobs above -- which independently proves the image preserved LF and that host/image code parity holds 2/2 for this arm. The forward-declaration finding on PR #138 is deliberately not repeated: no value in this file was written before an image produced it.
